title: Autonomous Organization
description: One record in the AO Commons registry. Schema version 0.1 — expect breaking changes until 1.0.

schema_version.description: Schema version this record was written against.

id.description: Stable slug. Must match the filename and never change once published — downstream citations depend on it.

name.description: The organization's own name for itself.

aliases.description: Former or alternative names, for searchability.

summary.description: What the organization does, in one or two neutral sentences. Descriptive, not promotional — no marketing copy.

status.description: Operating state as of the last verification.

launched.description: When the organization began operating, as YYYY or YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD — whatever precision the evidence supports.

categories.description: What the organization does. Multiple values allowed.

agent_roles.description: Which organizational functions AI agents hold. The defining dimension of this registry: an organization with no agent roles is not an AO. Use 'none-claimed' only for records under investigation.

autonomy_level.description: How much authority agents actually exercise. advisory: agents recommend, humans decide. delegated: agents decide within bounded mandates. supervised-autonomous: agents act independently with human veto or review after the fact. autonomous: agents act with no routine human checkpoint. Record what is evidenced, not what is claimed; use 'undetermined' when sources conflict.

human_oversight.description: How humans retain control in practice: veto rights, multisig thresholds, review cadence, kill switches. Prose, one or two sentences.

agent_stack.description: Frameworks, models, or platforms the organization's agents run on, as publicly documented. Not exhaustive and not an endorsement.

jurisdiction.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, or a subdivision code where it matters (e.g. US-WY).

contracts.description: Governance or treasury contracts, as chain-prefixed addresses (e.g. 'ethereum:0xabc...').

sources.description: Evidence for the claims in this record. At least one required — an unsourced entry is a rumor, not a registry record.

supports.description: Which fields this source is evidence for.

verification.description: How and when this record was last checked. Self-reported records are listed; they are just labelled honestly.

verified_by.description: Role or handle of the reviewer, not personal contact details.

airtable_record_id.description: Provenance link back to the Airtable base, which is the source of truth for this record.
